name: configure_camera_orbit

stack.evidence: func_001CBC20 consumes an angle, target mode, and distance and decrements Script stackTop by three

notes: func_001CBC20 converts angle_degrees to radians, derives an orbit basis through func_00178B58, and configures the camera controller at D_003C0D60 with target_mode and twice distance. A zero distance restores the default basis without activating the full orbit setup. The JP corpus contains 136 calls; common triples include (180, 0, 15), (265, 2, 30), and (285, 2, 30).
